olgasafonova-one-page-strategy-one-page-.description: Generates, validates, or refines a half-page strategy document using the One Page Strategy framework (Facts, Problem, Idea, Solution), with sequential dependency checks. Use when user says "one page strategy", "write a strategy", "strategy document", "review this strategy", or "refine this strategy". Do NOT use for a go/no-go decision (decision-gate), a feature spec (grill-me), sprint scoping (feature-scoping), or competitor research (competitive).
olgasafonova-one-page-strategy-one-page-.author: olgasafonova
